what_it_is: Low-profile minimally invasive pedicle screw system. Integrated blade design with 15 mm of built-in reduction threads. Ring allows precise rod contouring with secure fixation at various points along the blade. Three cutting flutes facilitate insertion. Cortical cancellous thread pattern matches pedicle anatomy for strong purchase.
sizing_specs: Accepts 5.5 mm and 6.0 mm pre-cut straight and pre-bent titanium rods.
compatible_with: Power and navigation capabilities. Compatible with Spine Guidance 5 and Mako Spine with Copilot features. LITe Pedicle Access System.
use_notes: Streamlined instrumentation designed for efficiency in MIS procedures. One system addresses multiple pathologies. Now sold by VB Spine.
